title: Named accountable owner
description: Assign accountable ownership for the AI use case and its lifecycle.

title: Documented intended use and prohibited use
description: Define intended use, users, boundaries and prohibited uses.

title: Risk acceptance authority
description: Define who can accept residual AI risk and under which conditions.

title: Data classification and handling
description: Classify data used by the AI system and apply handling requirements.

title: Training and retrieval data provenance
description: Maintain provenance and authorization for training, grounding and retrieval data.

title: Strong identity and authorization
description: Apply authenticated access, least privilege and authorization enforcement.

title: Prompt and input security
description: Assess and mitigate prompt injection, malicious inputs and instruction manipulation.

title: Retrieved-content trust controls
description: Treat retrieved content as untrusted and apply source, content and authorization controls.

title: Tool-use authorization
description: Restrict tool access and enforce explicit authorization for consequential actions.

title: Human approval for high-impact actions
description: Require approval gates where autonomous actions can create material impact.

title: Model and supplier due diligence
description: Assess model provenance, supplier controls, contractual safeguards and change risks.

title: Model change and version control
description: Track material model/version changes and reassess risk when required.

title: Security and misuse testing
description: Test expected, adversarial and misuse scenarios before deployment and after material change.

title: Quality and performance evaluation
description: Define and test acceptance criteria appropriate to the intended use.

title: Security logging and traceability
description: Log relevant AI interactions, tool actions, failures and security events.

title: Operational monitoring
description: Monitor model/system performance, anomalies and control failures.

title: Human oversight design
description: Define when and how humans review, override or intervene.

title: Privacy and personal-data controls
description: Apply minimization, access, retention and privacy requirements to personal data.

title: AI incident response
description: Extend incident procedures to AI-specific failure and abuse scenarios.

title: Fallback and safe failure
description: Define degraded-mode, fallback, shutdown and recovery behavior.

title: Controlled AI change process
description: Assess material changes to models, prompts, tools, data and architecture before release.
